user_sees: The list opens in a few seconds and scrolls; every count is the true total
must_not: A count that stops at a page size, missing rows of Gym list record, or a screen that freezes

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: Card 'Branch' with the box 'Add the members in this sheet to'
The branch on screen is picked, or the branch whose name the sheet carries
must_not: Rows sent to another branch without the box saying so

steps.action: Pick the other branch
user_sees: 'Opening <branch>… The Add button works once it is open.'
With several sheets: 'One sheet for each branch? Pick the branch for this sheet. When it is added, you can add the next sheet.'
must_not: The Add button working before that branch is open

steps.action: Tap the Add button and wait
user_sees: '<branch>: <n> members added.'
must_not: The members added to the branch on screen instead

note: Branch names in Hindi or longer than 40 letters (the box cuts them); the other branch empty or with 500 members to check repeats against
